title: The Boy Who Could Rewind Toast
narration: Every morning, Toby made the same breakfast. Toast, juice, and one very curious cat. But today, his toaster blinked with a golden light. Toby pressed its tiny button, and the toast suddenly popped back into the slot. He tried again. Pop. Rewind. Pop. Rewind. His cat, Miso, spotted the glowing button and leapt onto the counter. One accidental paw tap sent toast flying everywhere. Toby rushed to press the button one last time. Everything zipped backwards, the kitchen became quiet, and one perfect slice landed on the plate. Miso claimed it. Toby decided tomorrow would be cereal.
